title: Execution Request (v1)
description: Signed execution request constructed when a parked confirmation resumes with approval (SPEC-037 R-1). One envelope per approved parked tool call, built before any invocation happens. The signature is the HMAC-SHA256 hex over the canonical JSON of every other field in the envelope (sorted keys, no insignificant whitespace), keyed by the platform execution-signing key. args_digest is the SHA-256 hex of the canonical JSON of the parked arguments the approver saw on the confirmation card; the invocation boundary recomputes it from the executed arguments and blocks mismatches (SPEC-037 R-3).

execution_id.description: Fresh UUID minted per approved parked tool call; correlates the request with its receipt and the execution record.

confirm_id.description: The parked confirmation this execution was approved under (SPEC-031 record key).

call_id.description: The parked tool call id the request binds to; the invocation boundary matches the executing call against it.

session_id.description: Agent session that parked the confirmation.

owner_user_id.description: The session owner whose delegated token executes the call.

decider_user_id.description: The approver who resumed the confirmation (may differ from the owner for tier_2 approvals, SPEC-030 R-3).

tool_name.description: Sanitized tool name of the parked call.

args_digest.description: SHA-256 hex of the canonical JSON of the parked arguments.

requested_at.description: UTC timestamp (RFC 3339) of request construction at resume time.

signature.description: HMAC-SHA256 hex over the canonical JSON of the envelope excluding this field.
